# MUS-W-0004

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**A deterministic markdown export**

work-unit · 2026-08-19

Discharges: [MUS-M-0002](../milestones.md#mus-m-0002), [MUS-M-0003](../milestones.md#mus-m-0003)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0021](../decisions.md#mus-d-0021), [MUS-D-0024](../decisions.md#mus-d-0024)

The audit surface and the backup. StrucGu's checks speak in files, headings and links, and a database answers none of them.

## Depends on

MUS-W-0002.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0002, and the obligation MUS-D-0021 created: the audit at MUS-M-0003 runs against files.

## Done means

Exporting the same store twice produces byte-identical trees, asserted by a test that renders twice and compares.
No output carries the time of the run or any other value that changes without a record changing.
Every record is reachable from the export's index by a link that resolves, asserted by the repository's own link check over the committed tree.
A file left behind by an earlier export is removed by a later one.
The exported work-unit tree carries an index and a template, so the work-units module has the roles it names.

## Risks

The export is committed, so every insert produces a diff. That is the cost bought deliberately: a diff is how a reader who does not run the binary checks what happened.
Hand-editing the export is undetectable by the export itself. Verification is a separate command, and if it is not run the tree can drift from the store without anything saying so.
